scope: Theorem 4.2 (Ordinary interior injectivity) of the manuscript “Fourfold nonvanishing by minimal metrics and moving jets” (preprints/Fourfold-nonvanishing-by-minimal-metrics-and-moving-jets-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1946d50201ab1ae0), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 13. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The manuscript presents this as a result of other work, which it uses; the attribution names that work in the manuscript's own words. statement: Let V be a smooth projective complex variety and L an integral divisor. Let 0 ≤ C0 ≤ C2 be effective rational divisors whose combined support has simple normal crossings. Suppose the actual rational line bundles L − C0 and L − C2 have semipositive singular Hermitian metrics with zero Lelong numbers at every point. For a rational number 0 < λ < 1 put C1 = (1 − λ)C0 + λC2. The natural inclusion of sheaves induces an injection H1 (V, OV (KV + L − ⌊C1⌋)) −→ H1 (V, OV (KV + L − ⌊C0⌋)).
